entries.name: Agent harness supply-chain and pre-task authority controls
entries.why: Multiple independent sources demonstrate that prompt filtering does not control pre-task execution, mutable harness dependencies, or inherited tool authority.

entries.name: Step-labeled agent injection trajectory detection
entries.why: Released step-level labels can test delayed and partial hijacking, but synthetic/domain leakage prevents direct production conclusions.

entries.name: Single-tower multimodal-native document encoders
entries.why: Apache-2.0 artifacts and reported retrieval/storage gains justify a baseline comparison, not integration.

entries.name: Dependency-aware multimodal long-horizon agent evaluation
entries.why: Dependency-aware scoring exposes failure hidden by final answers; live-web drift requires frozen provenance fixtures.

entries.name: Local multimodal agentic models
entries.why: Muse Glimmer provides a commercially usable local candidate, but its own security results require strict external controls.

entries.name: Full-lifecycle trace trust evaluation
entries.why: Useful diagnostic composition, but current evidence is too small, judge-dependent, and non-reproducible.

entries.name: Managed durable agent harness APIs
entries.why: OpenAI's managed harness may be useful behind an adapter, but residency, retention, beta stability, and runtime lock-in block adoption.

entries.name: Bandwidth-adaptive edge-native MoE serving
entries.why: High reported performance is offset by CUDA lock-in, RAM/TCO, authentication, and early stability gaps.

entries.name: State-path tool menus
entries.why: Promising reported gain, but no usable implementation or reproducible benchmark release exists.

entries.name: Streaming factual and affective dual-brain memory
entries.why: Affective memory has potential, but missing data, non-portable latency, privacy, deletion, isolation, and poisoning controls dominate.

unchanged.name: MCP
unchanged.reason: No material dependency or implementation-state change.

unchanged.name: A2A
unchanged.reason: v1.0 and ecosystem evidence strengthened, but the existing dependency on MCP integration remains unsatisfied.
